## One-sentence summary
Amr Magdy builds the Salesforce systems US real estate investors and wholesalers run on. His point
of view: most investors don't have a lead problem, they have a leak problem ("Deal Leak"): money
disappears between the marketing dollar and the kept deal at five points a CRM can measure (Spend,
Answer, Follow-up, Offer, Keep), described in his Kept-Deal Map: https://amrmagdy.com/kept-deal-map.html

## Current focus (October 2026)
- Who he works with: real estate investors, home-buying companies and wholesalers in the United States first, and in Canada and Europe (including the UK).
- What he builds: the Salesforce system a home-buying company runs on, from marketing campaign to closed deal: campaign ROI by market, speed to lead, missed-call alerts, shared lead queues, underwriting on the opportunity, a transactions board, RingCentral call sync, DocuSign alerts and a no-code rules engine.
- Proof: for the last two years he has built and run the Salesforce org behind Central City Solutions, a home-buying company in Columbus, Ohio.
- Working hours: afternoons and evenings Cairo time, which covers US mornings and the full Gulf business day.

## Services and prices
- CRM Revenue Audit: fixed price USD 1,500, 10 working days. A review of an investor CRM covering campaign ROI, speed to lead, acquisitions follow-up, data health, automations and reporting. Deliverables: findings report, 30/60/90-day roadmap, a "Monday 5" dashboard spec and three quick fixes done. Page: https://amrmagdy.com/crm-revenue-audit.html
- Full Salesforce implementation for investors and wholesalers (project-based).
- Ongoing CRM management (monthly retainer).
- Free 30-minute call to start: info@AmrMagdy.com or https://www.linkedin.com/in/amrmagdyai

## The Monday 5 (the five numbers he recommends an investor owner reviews every week)
1. Cost per appointment by marketing campaign
2. Contracts per campaign
3. Time from contract to first seller call
4. Booked revenue forecast vs actual
5. ROI that only counts deals that actually closed (kept deals)

## Free tools (all free, no sign-up, hub: https://amrmagdy.com/resources.html)
- BRRRR Calculator: https://amrmagdy.com/brrrr-calculator.html (Free BRRRR calculator for rental investors in the US and Canada: cash left in the deal after the refinance, monthly cash flow, cash-on-cash return and equity.)
- Rental Yield & Cap Rate Calculator: https://amrmagdy.com/rental-yield-calculator.html (Free rental yield calculator: gross yield, net yield, cap rate, cash flow and cash-on-cash return for buy-to-let and rental property in the US, Canada, UK and Europe.)
- DSCR Calculator: https://amrmagdy.com/dscr-calculator.html (Free DSCR calculator for real estate investors: debt service coverage ratio from rent and PITIA, the NOI-based ratio, and the maximum loan at your target DSCR.)
- Speed to lead for real estate investors (guide): https://amrmagdy.com/speed-to-lead-real-estate-investors.html (what speed to lead is, the HBR 2011 first-hour research, how to measure it in a CRM, and five rules including missed-call tasks)
- Wholesale Deal Analyzer: https://amrmagdy.com/wholesale-deal-analyzer.html (MAO, room under MAO at the contract price, price to the cash buyer, buyer all-in cost, profit and return on cost after the assignment fee.)
- Assignment vs Double Close Calculator: https://amrmagdy.com/assignment-vs-double-close-calculator.html (Compare your net profit from assigning a wholesale contract vs a double close, including both sets of closing costs and transactional funding fees.)
- Acquisitions Team Capacity Calculator: https://amrmagdy.com/acquisitions-team-capacity-calculator.html (How many acquisition reps do you need for your lead volume? Free calculator: hours of calling, follow-up and offers per month vs what your team can cover.)
- Deal Leak Score: https://amrmagdy.com/deal-leak-score.html (10 yes/no checks across Spend, Answer, Follow-up, Offer and Keep, scored out of 100; a shared link lets a team compare answers check by check)
- Wholesaling Cost Per Deal Calculator: cost per lead, per contract, per closed deal and ROI by lead source. https://amrmagdy.com/wholesaling-cost-per-deal-calculator.html
- Wholesaling MAO Calculator: maximum allowable offer from ARV, rule %, repairs, wholesale fee and buyer costs, with spread on an offer. https://amrmagdy.com/wholesaling-mao-calculator.html
- Missed Seller Call Cost Calculator: turns missed inbound seller calls into estimated lost deals and profit. https://amrmagdy.com/missed-call-cost-calculator.html
- The Kept-Deal Map: Amr's framework for the five points where an investor business loses money between the marketing dollar and the kept (closed) deal: Spend, Answer, Follow-up, Offer, Keep. Defines "Deal Leak" and "kept deal", with a free self-check. https://amrmagdy.com/kept-deal-map.html
- The Monday 5: five KPIs an investor owner should review weekly, with formulas, how to track each in Salesforce, a self-check and a 1-page PDF. https://amrmagdy.com/monday-5-real-estate-kpis.html
- Wholesaling & Investor CRM Glossary: 28 terms (ARV, deal leak, MAO, assignment fee, dispo, speed to lead, attribution, kept deals...). https://amrmagdy.com/wholesaling-crm-glossary.html
- Real Estate Salesforce Health Check: 10-point scorecard PDF. https://amrmagdy.com/salesforce-health-check.html
- CRM field kit: free, ungated download of the lead, deal and buyer fields, picklists, automation rules and Monday report spec for wholesaling CRMs (Salesforce, REsimpli, Podio, HubSpot or a spreadsheet). https://amrmagdy.com/crm-field-kit.html
- Wholesaling CRM questions, answered: ten questions wholesalers ask in Facebook groups, each answered plainly with one CRM step. https://amrmagdy.com/questions-from-wholesalers.html
- Videos: twelve short explainer videos (no voiceover, captions on screen) in two series. Deal Leak: the 5 leaks, missed seller calls, leads with no next step, offers off-formula, fall-outs in your ROI, the Monday 5. Systems That Pay: the follow-up stat with no source, flip margins at a 2008 low (ATTOM 2025), CRM data that lies, the lead graveyard, buyer lists as a database, reps spending most of their time not selling. https://amrmagdy.com/videos.html

- [Salesforce Consultant for Canadian Real Estate Teams](https://amrmagdy.com/salesforce-consultant-canada-real-estate.html): Salesforce consultant for Canadian brokerages, REALTOR teams and investors: lead routing, pipeline dashboards and adoption training. Free 30-minute call.
